title: Insertion

inlines.v: INSER'TION, noun [Latin insertio.] 1. The act of setting or placing in or among other things; as the insertion of cions in stocks; the insertion of words or passages in writings; the insertion of notices or essays in a public paper; the insertion of vessels, tendons, etc. in other parts of the body. 2. The thing inserted.
